verdict.rationale: Slack documents a workspace data export feature and an import/export tools guide, so some export path exists, and the Web API allows querying workspace data. However, a community report says exporting DMs and private channels requires legal or compliance justification plus Slack's approval, so 'all of my data' is not freely exportable. Missing for 10: documented export file formats (open/standard formats like JSON), evidence that a full export including DMs and private channels is self-serve, and hands-on corroboration of a complete migration out.
